name: AUA Variance Analysis
description: Segment-level decomposition of ~$55M gap between BD allocations (~$1.60B non-cash AUA) and our gold layer model (~$1.545B non-cash AUA) as of 2026-03-02. 49Financial leadership relies on BD numbers. Prior DS investigation found root cause is fundamental data source difference (snapshot vs reconstructed timeseries). Project goal: identify which segments explain the gap so we can explain or address them.
phase: COMPLETE (2026-03-09). Full $73.6M gap attributed. BKF forward-fill fix (91b1918a) deployed to EC2. Post-rebuild accuracy: 99.1% non-cash vs BD investment-only. Rebuild deferred until after ADVI_49FNV3 (combined with NNAVAR JNL/sweep in one gold rebuild). No open questions.
